header: Half an hour, and you have seen the till you would be buying
lead: Send us three of your own articles beforehand and you will watch your prices go over the counter rather than our imaginary bakery's.
note: The demonstration is given by somebody who installs tills, not by sales. We record it if you ask and not if you do not.

agenda.title: Ten minutes of selling
agenda.text: Receipt, void, card, refund — the handful of moves your counter staff make a hundred times a day.

agenda.title: Ten minutes of figures
agenda.text: Cashing up, article groups, and what a branch quietly loses on a Tuesday afternoon.

agenda.title: Five minutes of setup
agenda.text: How an article list comes in from your old till, and where that usually goes wrong.

agenda.title: Five minutes of questions
agenda.text: Which are generally the ten minutes that decide it.
